title: Sabine Wren
subtitle: Explosives Artist
text:
While there are at least 3 aspects among other friendly units, this unit can't be attacked (unless she gains Sentinel).

On Attack: You may deal 1 damage to the defender or to a base.
rules:
Sabine’s first ability requires 3 different aspects among other friendly units.
If a unit that can't be attacked gains Sentinel, it can be attacked.
(ERRATA) Templating update: “Defender” becomes “defending unit”.
